title: Missing data
text: SRTR data often uses non-standard codes represent missingness — "","U", "ND", "C: Disclose" — can vary variable. srtr_normalize_missing() function helps harmonize values converting NA user-specified label like "Missing". Internally, uses built-dictionary variable-specific missing codes drawn SRTR documentation known conventions. can also pass custom list codes using missing_vals argument.
code: tx_li <- load_srtr_file("TX_LI", var_labels = TRUE, factor_labels = TRUE)  # Replace common SRTR missing codes (e.g., "U", "", "ND") with NA tx_li <- srtr_normalize_missing(tx_li)  # Replace missing codes and NAs with an explicit label tx_li <- srtr_normalize_missing(tx_li, replacement = "Missing") # Load the data tx_li <- load_srtr_file("TX_LI", var_labels = TRUE, factor_labels = TRUE)  # Define custom missing codes for specific variables custom_missing_vals <- list(   REC_HIV_STAT = c("U", ""),              # "Unknown" or blank   REC_HCV_STAT = c("ND: Not Done", "U"),  # Custom-labeled values   REC_CMVD = c(-1, 999),                  # Numeric codes   DON_RACE = c("99", "Unknown")           # Other arbitrary codes )  # Apply normalization, replacing with NA tx_li_clean <- srtr_normalize_missing(tx_li, missing_vals = custom_missing_vals)  # Or, replace all with an explicit label tx_li_labeled <- srtr_normalize_missing(tx_li, missing_vals = custom_missing_vals, replacement = "Missing")

title: Add time-to-event follow-up outcomes to a transplant cohort — add_txf_outcomes
text: FIRST_FU_MALIG_DATE — first follow-malignancy date per TRR_ID FIRST_FU_REJ_DATE_{ORG} — first acute rejection date per organ code (e.g., FIRST_FU_REJ_DATE_KI, FIRST_FU_REJ_DATE_PA) function limits follow-load cohort's TRR_IDs efficiency, merges derived dates back df. helper: Infers follow-table key attr(df, "file_key"). Loads follow-subset cohort's TRR_IDs via load_srtr_file(). Normalizes organ two-letter code (ORG_TYPE := first two characters ORG_TY), selects core follow-fields, orders TRR_ID TFL_PX_STAT_DT. Computes earliest malignancy date per TRR_ID TFL_MALIG == "Y". Computes earliest acute rejection date per (TRR_ID, ORG_TYPE) TFL_ACUTE_REJ_EPISODE indicates least one treated episode, pivots wide organ-specific columns. Left-joins results back df. Assumptions/requirements follow-table contains: TRR_ID, ORG_TY, TFL_PX_STAT_DT, TFL_MALIG, TFL_ACUTE_REJ_EPISODE. TFL_PX_STAT_DT Date; stored YYYYMMDD, convert upstream (e.g., .Date(.character(x), "%Y%m%d")). Rejection identified labeled value "1: Yes, least one episode treated anti-rejection agent". Adjust filter coding differs. Notes Combined organ codes (e.g., "HL") split; produce column FIRST_FU_REJ_DATE_HL. prefer split heart/lung, duplicate rows pivoting. function derives event dates. build full time--event variables (censor date, indicator, elapsed time), pass dates srtr_time_to_event() helper along transplant last-follow-dates.
